_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Anxiety with flat 30d tape and two-way extremes canceling; statistically this is a coil so HOLD is the graded base-rate call until a one-sided ETF/fear-greed breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD; narrative silent on forward path and only confirms current Anxiety
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, fear/greed holds ~45-55, no sustained ETF-flow impulse either way
next_move.invalidated_if: multi-day ETF inflow surge with fear/greed >62, or flush driving fear/greed <39 with funding negative
